Reporting my screenshots to the other person is disabled.

Optional exchange of screenshot events in private cloud chats on Android 14+. When Android reports a screenshot while a normal conversation is active, CapybaraGram sends the other person a Telegram service notification. This reveals that you viewed the chat even with silent reading enabled. No image, precise region or specific message is claimed. Secret chats and one-time media retain their existing Telegram behavior. Android does not report every capture method. This setting cannot detect another person using a client that does not report their screenshots. Enabled only after your choice; no screenshot pixels are stored.
This OS detector requires Android 14 or later. Existing Telegram screenshot events remain available.
